papers.title: SensorFM: A Wearable Health Foundation Model Pretrained on One Trillion Minutes of Sensor Data
papers.what: A self-supervised foundation model over five wearable sensors, pretrained by masked reconstruction on one trillion-plus minutes from about 5 million people; the largest variant beats conventional baselines on 34 of 35 tasks.
papers.builds_on: SSL for HAR (Yuan 2024); Foundation Models for Biosignals (Gu 2025); HeAR (Baur 2024)

papers.title: HEARTS: Benchmarking LLM Reasoning on Health Time Series
papers.what: A benchmark of 16 datasets, 12 health domains, 20 signal modalities and 110 tasks that shows state-of-the-art LLMs underperform specialized models and fail at multi-step temporal reasoning on health signals.

papers.title: Group Entropy-Controlled Policy Optimization (GEPO)
papers.what: A lightweight GRPO extension that shapes advantages by per-group entropy, damping over-exploitation in low-entropy groups and preserving exploration in high-entropy groups to stabilize reasoning RL on heterogeneous task mixtures.

papers.title: Environment-free Synthetic Data Generation for API-Calling Agents
papers.what: Generates synthetic tool-call training data without a live executable environment, letting API-calling agent datasets scale with generation rather than with sandbox availability.
